profile_notes: Astrophotography lives or dies on the sensor: low read noise, clean output at high ISO (typically ISO 3200-6400 for Milky Way work), and wide dynamic range to hold faint nebula detail against a dark sky. That maps directly onto sensor_performance, which is weighted highest (3) and is the dominant ranking lens for this use case. image_quality (2) carries resolution and tonal rendering that let faint structure survive processing. color_rendition (1) matters mildly for star color and nebula hue. evf_lcd (1) helps because framing and manual-focusing on a point star relies on live-view magnification / a bright articulating screen in the dark. build (1) reflects cold-night and dew-resistance sealing; handling (1) reflects ease of operating an intervalometer/long-exposure workflow blind in the dark; battery_life (1) because cold nights and long sessions drain cells fast. Axes deliberately OMITTED (effective weight 0) because astro is a tripod, manual-focus-at-infinity, single-long-exposure discipline: autofocus_body, af_performance, burst_buffer, video_capability, connectivity, and stabilization (IBIS is largely inert during multi-second tripod exposures). GATE DECISION: require is intentionally EMPTY. The astro-relevant body specs (iso_native, resolution_mp, sensor_format, fps_electronic, af_low_light_ev) are populated on only ~6-8 of 48 bodies, so any hard gate would silently empty the guide; ranking is driven entirely by axis weights per the population-reality guidance. gear_class excludes novelty only. OPEN QUESTION for Lee: (a) do we want a soft near-universal floor on sensor_format (e.g. exclude sub-1-inch / phone-class sensors) IF that spec becomes better populated, since tiny sensors are genuinely poor for astro? Left out for now to avoid emptying the guide. (b) Should stabilization stay at 0, or lift to 1 for the handful of bodies with sky-tracking / astro-IBIS modes? Left at 0 (omitted) pending your call. Research basis: skyatnightmagazine, space.com, livescience, petapixel/lonelyspeck on ISO-invariance and read noise. Ratified by Lee 2026-09-14
